name: admiration
quote: I like the way she brushed off that insult.
description: Judgment that a person has unusually worthy attitude, talent, or skill.

variations.name: admiration of nature
variations.description: Admiration can be used outside of the social world in which case it's probably related to wonder. e.g. 'I admire the organization of the ant colony.'

variations.name: inspirational admiration
variations.description: Admiring traits that we would like to exhibit ourselves.

variations.name: admiration of the unusual
variations.description: A sense that another person is different from others in a good or interesting way.

conditions: An agent positively exceeds an exepected pattern within a given context.
